title: 第一卷 第13章 需要关注的对手，又增加了！
slug: 开局自曝系统家族助我娶妻成仙

第(1/3)页

相较于太凰仙朝的苦大仇深，炎阳仙舟之上，却是另一派光景。

沐凝薇紧靠在沐云溪身边，怯生生的看着仙舟内部如宫殿般奢华的装饰。

她虽然背负着郡主的身份，却自幼跟随沐云溪住在朴素的溪凝苑内，处于半囚禁状态。

就算她并未被禁足，但由于身份敏感，一般也不会去太远的地方，以免碰上麻烦。

如今跟着姜无痕，稀里糊涂的上了‘贼船’，她就像是个好奇宝宝，看到什么都感到新奇。

“娘亲，我们这是要去什么地方？”

沐凝薇轻声询问，目光却被面前桌案上的奇珍异果牢牢吸引住。

沐云溪将她揽入怀中，轻声劝慰道：“我们要去一个没人欺负我们的地方，从此以后，我们也有依靠了……”

“依靠……”沐凝薇似懂非懂，仰起小脸问道，“是那个在溪凝苑，一直占娘亲便宜的家伙吗？”

“不许这样说，以后……她就是你爹爹了……”

沐云溪纠正道。

“爹爹……”

沐凝薇呢喃着这两个字，心里隐隐有种异样的感觉。

却在这时，一只大手落在她头顶，轻轻抚摸着她的小脑袋。

“乖女儿，真懂事，再叫一声听听？”

姜无痕的声音，随之响起。

沐凝薇身子一僵，下意识的想要躲开，却见姜无痕已经坐在了她身边。

“帝子，凝薇还需要一段时间的适应，才能接受这个称呼……”

沐云溪巧笑嫣然，解释道。

“那你呢？”姜无痕看着她，饶有兴致的道，“方才在溪凝苑，喊‘夫君’不是喊得挺顺口的吗？现在怎么又变回‘帝子’了？”

沐云溪俏脸一红，脸上露出少女般的娇羞：“那是为了气沐乾钊他们，‘夫君’这个称呼，还是要成亲之后才能喊……”

“早晚的事！”姜无痕从桌上拿起一枚仙果，放在沐云溪唇边，轻笑道，“来，张嘴，夫君喂给你。”

“我自己来……”

她面露娇羞，但姜无痕的霸道，又容不得她拒绝。

无奈之下，沐云溪闭上眼睛，红着脸吃下了那枚仙果。

柔软的唇舌触碰到姜无痕的指尖，心中升起一股异样的感觉。

“好吃吗？”

Page (1/3)

Compared with the suffering and hatred in the Taihuang Immortal Dynasty, there was a different situation on the Yanyang Immortal Boat.

Mu Ningwei stood close to Mu Yunxi and timidly looked at the luxurious palace-like decoration inside the fairy boat.

Although she carries the identity of a princess, she has lived with Mu Yunxi in the simple Xining Garden since she was a child, in a state of semi-imprisonment.

Even if she is not grounded, due to her sensitive status, she usually does not go too far to avoid getting into trouble.

Now following Jiang Wuhen, she boarded the 'thief ship' in a daze. She was like a curious baby, finding everything she saw novel.

"Mom, where are we going?"

Mu Ningwei asked softly, but her eyes were firmly attracted by the rare fruits on the table in front of her.

Mu Yunxi hugged her and comforted her softly: "We are going to a place where no one bullies us. From now on, we will have someone to rely on..."

"Rely on..." Mu Ningwei seemed to understand, raised her little face and asked, "Is he the guy who has been taking advantage of my mother in Xiningyuan?"

"Don't say that. From now on...she will be your father..."

Mu Yunxi corrected.

"Daddy..."

Mu Ningwei murmured these two words, feeling a strange feeling in her heart.

But at this moment, a big hand landed on top of her head, gently stroking her little head.

"My dear daughter, you are so sensible. Can you call me again?"

Jiang Wuhen's voice sounded immediately.

Mu Ningwei stiffened and subconsciously wanted to hide away, but saw Jiang Wuhen already sitting next to her.

"Emperor, Ningwei still needs some time to adapt before she can accept this title..."

Mu Yunxi smiled sweetly and explained.

"What about you?" Jiang Wuhen looked at her and said with great interest, "Didn't you say 'husband' quite smoothly in Xiningyuan just now? Why have you changed back to 'the emperor' now?"

Mu Yunxi's pretty face turned red, with a girlish shyness on her face: "That's to anger Mu Qianzhao and the others. The title 'husband' can only be called 'husband' after getting married..."

"It's a matter of time!" Jiang Wuhen picked up a fairy fruit from the table, placed it on Mu Yunxi's lips, and said with a chuckle, "Come on, open your mouth, I will feed it to you."

"I'll do it myself..."

She looked shy, but Jiang Wuhen was too domineering and could not tolerate her rejection.

In desperation, Mu Yunxi closed her eyes and ate the fairy fruit with a blushing face.

The soft lips and tongue touched Jiang Wuhen's fingertips, and a strange feeling arose in his heart.

"Is it delicious?"
